name: fireworks
summary:
Successfully completed the Fireworks AI quickstart and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response "¡Hola!" was returned when asking the model to "Say hello in Spanish".

Steps completed:
1. Fetched the quickstart documentation from https://docs.fireworks.ai/getting-started/quickstart
2. Followed the Python (OpenAI SDK) path from the quickstart
3. Installed/verified openai package was available
4. Created the script at /home/daytona/fireworks_quickstart.py using the FIREWORKS_API_KEY environment variable
5. The model specified in the docs (accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1) returned a 404 "Model not found" error
6. Queried the available models endpoint and selected accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2 (a chat-capable model)
7. Ran the script successfully and received the chat completion response: "¡Hola!"
deviations: The quickstart documentation specifies model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but this model returned a 404 Not Found error ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). I had to query the available models endpoint and substitute a working model (accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2) to complete the quickstart successfully.

first_call.evidence: openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}

friction.detail: Fetched quickstart URL returned an HTML documentation index instead of the actual quickstart instructions: "Serverless Quickstart - Fireworks AI Docs Documentation Index Fetch the complete documentation index at: /llms.txt"

friction.where: Model selection in first API call
friction.detail: The initial script used a model that returned 404, indicating the docs or agent selected an inaccessible model: "model=\"accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1\"" leading to "openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'"

After the documented/hard-coded model failed, the agent had to manually query the models endpoint to find a valid one: "curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY\" https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models | head -c 2000"

The docs response was cluttered with navigation markup rather than a clean quickstart guide: "Skip to main content Fireworks AI Docs home page Documentation API & SDK Reference CLI Reference Demos Changelog Resources Community Status Dashboard"
